summary: A single-threaded Observable<T> with sink, map, remove_duplicates and cancel-on-drop subscriptions covers the CurrentValueSubject and @Published cases. Operators, schedulers, publishers, back pressure and threading are missing.

features.note: only map and remove_duplicates; no filter, merge, combineLatest, debounce, flatMap
cancel on drop and store(in:) bag

features.apple: Future, Just, Deferred, Empty, Fail, Record
